t: This is 15 Templewood Avenue, a twentieth-century house in Hampstead, right beside number fourteen. It was designed by C. H. B. Quennell, an English architect, designer, illustrator and historian. The heritage architect Cath Layton says his great influence can be felt in the houses and streets of London's suburbs and across the country. He also wrote books for children and young people, and his Nature obituary said they stimulated interest in the cultural background of history. Look at this house as one small piece of that wider suburban influence.
